style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the one picture is a golden satin ribbon (the length bar): golden satin keys in the ribbon's own family, a rose-pink Enter as the treat of the same world, butter soft keys, a very light panel; no red, no violet.

images.why: Look 'length bars along the bottom' / Stage 'each length drawn to one scale in its colours, laid end to end for a sum and one along the other for a difference': a length that is measured, added and taken from is a satin ribbon (IMAGES.md section 3, a length). One skin for every bar of every phase and every unit pair; the deep-blue whole units, the green leftover and the reddish-purple difference are drawn in code over it, light gold so those colours read on it.
images.prompt: A long straight length of pale golden-yellow satin ribbon with fine woven edges and a smooth, soft sheen that glows gently along its length, the same light buttery gold from end to end.
